basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old gamer based in Toronto, Canada. I'm passionate about RPGs and have recently gotten into virtual reality games like Blade and Sorcery. I usually play games in the evenings after work, where I am a junior software developer. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends exploring new games or watching sci-fi movies. I'm still learning the ropes on Reddit, so I mainly lurk and occasionally ask questions when I get stuck in games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in computer science and have always been interested in technology and gaming. Most of my gaming knowledge comes from personal experience and watching gaming streams on platforms like Twitch. I'm new to VR gaming, so I'm still learning about the technical aspects and community tips.
